summary: FD_TC_211_3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Not in CS � Non-EU Country � Rejected
title: 3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Not in CS � Non-EU Country � Rejected
description:
Validates that when a claims company submits on behalf of a passenger, the claim was opened by the passenger, the case number is not found in CS, and the country of origin is a non-EU country (e.g., Canada), the system rejects the third-party submission and advises the passenger to file themselves.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Claims Company. Passenger has opened a claim. Case number provided does not exist in Case Services. Country of origin: Canada.
